features.title: Paste session mentions as reference chips
features.summary: Pasted canonical thread mentions keep their structured label and reference behavior in the composer.

The original clipboard HTML is never inserted into the composer DOM.

verification.testName: turns canonical session mentions into structured references and preserves surrounding text

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Paste session mentions as reference chips renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Add inline references for image attachments
features.summary: When an image enters the composer, it gets an ordered inline reference in the draft so users can point to specific screenshots in their message.
failureModes: An image rejected by attachment validation does not get an inline reference.
References preserve attachment order and remain tied to the image draft id.
reach: expect textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions"

verification.testName: inserts ordered inline labels tied to each image attachment

telemetry.reason: Client-side draft composition: image labels are added to the editor alongside the existing attachment admission flow, with no new Host work.

features.title: Rename a thread from its header title
features.summary: Clicking the current Session title in the main view header opens an in-place editor focused on the whole title. Enter or leaving the field commits the trimmed title through the Session rename API, Escape cancels, and a blank or unchanged draft closes without a Host call. The header keeps the breadcrumb shape, so ancestor crumbs still navigate and a subagent's lineage switcher is unchanged.
failureModes: A rename the Host refuses keeps the editor open with an error and the previous title stays on the thread.
An unchanged or blank draft closes the editor without a Host call.

verification.reason: The in-place header editor is exercised end to end by its scratch reach; mounting the slot in a unit harness would require the full Conversation runtime.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Rename a thread from its header title renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.
